description: Normalized token market snapshot (price, liquidity, FDV, volume, age). $0.005 USDC.

address.description: Public token contract address on the selected chain. EVM addresses use 0x plus 40 hexadecimal characters; Solana uses its base58 mint address.

chain.description: Lowercase chain identifier used by the data provider, for example base, ethereum or solana. Coverage varies by tool and upstream data availability.

payment.description: Optional base64-encoded x402 payment payload returned by an authorized payment client, not a private key or API token. Omit to receive payment requirements. A successful authorized call may settle a USDC charge; repeated paid calls may charge again.

name: token_snapshot
title: Token Snapshot
